title: BunkPro — Daily attendance reminder deep-link and robustness

requirements.summary: Ensure the daily attendance reminder notification uses the exact required English title/body strings and remains deduped to at most once per local calendar day via settings.lastReminderDate.
acceptanceCriteria: When a reminder notification is sent, its title is exactly "Attendance Not Marked 📢".
When a reminder notification is sent, its body is exactly "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now." (including the curly apostrophe).
If settings.lastReminderDate equals today’s local YYYY-MM-DD string, no reminder is sent again that day.

file_operations.description: Update the reminder notification payload to use the exact required Title and Body strings (including the curly apostrophe), while keeping the existing settings.lastReminderDate local YYYY-MM-DD dedupe check as the source of truth.

requirements.summary: When the user clicks the reminder notification while the app is running, focus the window and automatically navigate to Home and open the existing Mark Today’s Classes bottom sheet.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the reminder notification focuses the app window/tab.
After clicking the reminder notification, the app navigates to the Home tab if needed and opens the existing MarkTodaySheet UI (the same UI opened by the Dashboard button).
The click behavior works even if the user is currently on Timetable/Stats/Rank/Settings.
No immutable frontend paths are modified.

file_operations.description: Lift control of the existing MarkTodaySheet to the app shell level so it can be opened from both the Dashboard button and from the reminder notification click handler; ensure the handler also switches the current tab/route to Home before opening the sheet.
Wire the existing "Mark Today's Classes" button to call a parent-provided open handler (instead of only local state), so the same MarkTodaySheet instance can be opened by the notification click flow.
Provide an onClick handler to the notification send call (via notificationsApi) that triggers the app-level navigation-to-Home + open-MarkTodaySheet behavior.

requirements.summary: Harden reminder scheduling so it only schedules checks when notifications and Streak Reminders are enabled, cleans up timers reliably, and never attempts to send before 7:00 PM local time.
acceptanceCriteria: If settings.enableNotifications is false or settings.notificationPreferences.streakReminders is false, the reminder hook does not schedule any interval checks.
When the reminder hook is active, it never triggers a notification attempt before 19:00 local time.
Intervals/timeouts created by the reminder hook are cleaned up on unmount and when dependency conditions change, with no accumulating intervals over time.

file_operations.description: Refactor the effect to be leak-free: always clear any existing interval/timeout on dependency changes and unmount; only create scheduling when both master notifications and the streak reminders category are enabled; ensure the check function returns before any send attempt prior to 19:00 local time.

requirements.summary: Show clear, user-friendly, non-blocking (toast/alert pattern) feedback when reminders are configured but cannot be sent due to browser limitations, with rate-limited messaging and no raw error text.
acceptanceCriteria: If a reminder attempt fails due to unsupported notifications, permission denied/default, or notifications disabled, the user receives a clear English non-blocking message (toast/alert pattern consistent with the app).
Failure messaging is rate-limited so it is not shown repeatedly in a short period (no spam).
The app never displays raw technical error text to users for reminder-related failures.

file_operations.description: Add a small helper that maps notificationsApi failure reasons to user-friendly English messages and enforces rate-limiting (e.g., via in-memory ref and/or localStorage timestamps) so reminder-related failure feedback is not noisy.

When a reminder send attempt fails for unsupported API, permission denied/default, or disabled notifications, show a non-blocking toast (using the app’s existing sonner toast pattern) with a friendly message from the new helper, and ensure messages are rate-limited and never show raw technical text.
